def count_blue_seats(image_path):
    detection = ObjectDetector.execute(label_string="chair", image_path=image_path, threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny")

    return len(blue_seats)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from object_detector_tool import *
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def load_image(image_path):
    img = Image.open(image_path)
    return img

def predict_labels(img, labels, threshold):
    img_arr = np.array(img)
    predictions, threshold = predict(img_arr, labels)
    predictions = predictions[:, 1:]  # Remove the background label and keep only the predicted labels
    return predictions

def analyze_images(image_paths):
    all_labels = []
    for image_path in image_paths:
        img = load_image(image_path)
        predictions = predict_labels(img, labels, threshold)
        for p in predictions:
            all_labels.append(p[0])
        plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))
        plt.scatter(all_labels, color="r", label="Predicted Labels")
    plt.scatter(np.arange(0, len(all_labels), 1), color="gray", label="True Labels")
    plt.xlabel("Predicted Labels")
    plt.ylabel("True Labels")
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    label_image_paths = ["path/to/image.png", "path/to/image.png"]
    labels = ["baseball", "basket"]
    threshold = 0.35
    model_size = "tiny"
    padding = 20

    analyze_images(label_image_paths)
